name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
summary: At Karnitol's wreck, you find the chest open and empty. Deep scratches score its sides and top, so you return to Kreldig Ungor at Nijel's Point.

sections.title: An Empty Chest
sections.body: The chest lies empty, its sides and top scored with long, deep scratches. The marks suggest neither man nor giant forced it open. They look unlike cuts from a dagger or sword. With nothing more to learn, you close the chest and prepare to leave. Kreldig Ungor will be disappointed.

faq.answer: Nothing remains in Karnitol's chest. It is completely empty.

faq.q: What made the marks on the chest?
faq.answer: Long, deep scratches score the chest's sides and top. They suggest neither man nor giant made them, and do not look like dagger or sword cuts.

aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: You report to Kreldig Ungor at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Before this, Kreldig Ungor asked you to search for Karnitol's chest.
